name: Juice Bar
notes: Work-list name 'Juice Bar' matches address exactly (909 Grand Ave, San Diego) to 'Bahia Mexican Food & PB Juice Bar' -- a combined Mexican-food/juice-bar business at that address (prior tenant at same address, Shakeaway, is permanently closed per Yelp). No independent restaurant website. Sourced from the DoorDash marketplace listing's schema.org Menu JSON-LD (server-rendered, no browser needed). Markup check passed: dividing by 1.2/1.15/1.1/1.04 gave at most 28.6% clean-cent landings (1.2), well short of the ~75-100% signature of a real markup, and prices are POS-style odd cents ($8.10, $11.40, $17.40) consistent with a real menu, not a divisor. Captured all 16 menu sections on the listing: Most Ordered, Tortas (x2), Seafood Appetizers, Fruit Salad, Soups & Salads, Salads, Seafood Soups, Seafood Cocktails, Chimichangas, Enchiladas, Combos, Quesadillas, More Delicious Food, Burritos, Seafood Platter -- this is a complete Mexican-food menu. However the 'PB Juice Bar' half of the business (smoothies, tropical/green juice, wraps, acai berry bowls) is NOT represented beyond a single 'Acai Bowl small $8.50' in Most Ordered -- the delivery listing evidently does not carry that side of the menu for online ordering. Grubhub and Uber Eats listings for the same business are client-rendered JS shells and returned no data via curl; Yelp 403s curl. This is the best available source; the juice/smoothie side of the menu could not be confirmed priced anywhere reachable without a browser.

name: The American Acai Cafe
blocked: Own site (theamericanacaicafe.com/menu) gives only category-level price RANGES ($13.00-$25.00 Acai/Cupuacu Bowls, $3.50-$6.75 Coffee, $10.00-$12.50 Smoothies, $3.50-$5.75 Pastries, $2.75-$5.50 Soft Drinks), not per-item prices -- confirmed by stripping tags and checking, only 6 dollar-figures on the whole page, all ranges. Real per-item ordering is at the-american-acai-cafe-san-diego-3.cloveronline.com, Clover's hosted COLO2 React SPA (no server-rendered prices, no reachable REST endpoint) -- needs a browser. DoorDash marketplace listing (address-matched: 1001 Garnet Ave, San Diego) has full per-item prices but a confirmed 1.3x markup: dividing by 1.3 gave 92.2% of 51 prices landing on round/.99/.75/.50/.25 values (BYO Cup/Bowl $16.90->$13.00, 32oz $32.50->$25.00, matching the site's own stated bowl range exactly at both ends), so it is unusable per the no-construct-a-price rule even though the divided figures fit the site's stated ranges. Yelp menu tab is barred and the business page 403s curl / CAPTCHA-gates the jina.ai reader, so no dated menu photo could be checked. Needs: a browser on cloveronline.com to read the real per-item prices.
notes: Address-verified (1001 Garnet Ave Ste 105, San Diego). No priced dishes recorded -- see blocked reason.

name: Bottlecraft
notes: not_found: Bottlecraft North Park (3007 University Ave, San Diego -- address matches work list exactly) is a craft beer shop / tasting room: ~12 beers on draft plus hundreds of bottles, no kitchen, no food. Checked the restaurant's own site (bottlecraft.com/locations/north-park-beer-shop/ and /beers-on-tap/, both stripped-tag scanned, zero dollar figures), the TapHunter beer-list widget the shop itself links to (comprehensive -- ~87 beers, ABV/IBU/brewery for each, only ONE dollar figure on the whole page: a $35 price for a 'kranz' -- a multi-glass Kolsch serving rack, a specialty format, not representative per-pour pricing), and WebSearch (no pour-price menu found; Wine-Searcher gates its pricing behind login). Untappd and the site's own /shop/ path both 403. This is a beer shop/tasting room that genuinely does not publish per-item pour or bottle prices online -- matches the playbook's 'a brewery's beer board may genuinely print nothing' case. Not a menu once the single non-representative $35 item is excluded.

name: La Rosa Giant Pizza
blocked: Work-list entry 'La Rosa Giant Pizza' at 1680 Broadway #G matches 'Rosa Giant Pizza', 1680 Broadway Ste G, Chula Vista, CA (address confirmed exact on the restaurant's own NetWaiter about page, which also confirmed via Apple Maps link '1680 Broadway G in Chula Vista, CA'). No independent restaurant website found. Its online-ordering platform is NetWaiter (tier-2, own platform) -- rosagiantpizza.netwaiter.com/chula-vista/about/ is server-rendered (checked, 0 dollar figures -- it's a hours/location page) but the actual menu/order flow redirects to my.netwaiter.com, a client-rendered JS SPA with no reachable per-item REST endpoint found via curl. No DoorDash, Grubhub, or Uber Eats storefront exists for this business (WebSearch for both name variants came back empty or matched unrelated same-named restaurants in other cities). zmenu.com 403s; restaurantguru.com has only an aggregate '$10-$20 per person' price-range badge, no per-item prices. Yelp 403s curl for both the business page and photos. Needs: a browser on my.netwaiter.com (chain=883be8dc-6621-e511-941c-00155d06083c) to read the real per-item pizza/menu prices.
notes: Old-school family pizzeria, cash-only per web summaries; a real per-item priced menu almost certainly exists on the NetWaiter storefront, just not reachable without a browser.

name: La Gran Terraza
notes: Restaurant is O'Toole's / La Gran Terraza, University of San Diego's on-campus fine-dining room, at 5998 Alcala Park Way -- matches work list address exactly (menu header reads 'UNIVERSITY OF SAN DIEGO'). Own Wix site (lagranterraza.com) links 4 first-party PDF menus directly in the page HTML. pdftotext -layout scrambled/dropped many prices where the PDF used a small dot-separator glyph instead of extractable text, so both food PDFs were read visually with the Read tool (per playbook) rather than trusted from pdftotext -- recovered soup cup/bowl prices, salad add-on prices, and the full beverage list that pdftotext had silently dropped. Two food PDFs (Lunch; and the Shareables/Salads/Plates dinner menu, labelled 'O'Toole's La Gran Terraza') overlap heavily (same salads, same add-on prices, several shared entrees at identical prices) -- treated as one cross-check: every overlapping dish/price matched exactly between the two documents, so duplicates were recorded once. A third PDF (Beer/Wine list) was also read visually and its numbers (which pdftotext rendered with no '$' at all) are real per-item prices printed on the document -- included as Beer and Wine sections. The draft-beer price grid ($7 12oz / $8 16oz / $24 pitcher) is a flat rate across all listed taps, not a per-beer price, and is recorded as three generic 'Local Draft Beer' rows rather than fabricating a price per beer name; each tap beer this rate covers is named in that row's description. A fourth PDF ('Summer 2026 Special Event Menus') is a private-event/catering/buffet packet -- excluded as an adjunct, not the walk-in menu. Categories reached: Lunch (Soups, Salads, Entrees, Desserts, Beverages), Shareables, Plates, Dinner Desserts, Dinner Beverages, Beer (draft + bottled/canned), Wine (by the glass + by the bottle). Categories not reached / excluded: the private-event catering PDF (adjunct, by design).

name: Nacho Taco Shop
blocked: Address confirmed: Yelp and restaurantguru both list 'Nachos Taco Shop' at 681 S Rancho Santa Fe Rd, San Marcos, CA (restaurantguru URL slug says 'San-Diego' but its own address/phone match San Marcos exactly, phone -0797). No independent restaurant website. allmenus.com carries a full per-item priced menu (schema.org JSON-LD, 15 sections, ~70 items -- Hamburgers, Tortas, Tacos, Burritos, Enchiladas, A La Carte, Specials, Combinations, Side Orders, Desserts, Drinks) but the price level is implausible for 2026: full combination plates (protein + rice + beans + tortillas) at $7.49-$8.85, a 4oz side of guacamole at $0.95, soda at $1.30, coffee at $1.39, tacos at $2.20-$2.85 -- consistent with a listing dating to roughly 2010-2012, not current pricing, per the playbook's price-level staleness rule. menutoeat.com's page for this restaurant is actually a 'Restaurant Not Found' 404 -- its Next.js RSC payload does contain dollar figures ($8.40, $6.95, etc.) but they belong to an unrelated 'ThePriceBoard' placeholder widget on the 404 page itself, confirmed by reading the surrounding JSON (children:'Restaurant Not Found' / 'The restaurant you're looking for doesn't exist'), not to this business -- correctly excluded per the strip-tags-and-verify-it's-your-restaurant rule. Uber Eats has a storefront ('Nacho's Taco Shop & Seafood') but redirects to a bot-detection challenge page (def.uber.com/challenge) -- needs a browser. zmenu.com CAPTCHA-gates both direct curl and the jina.ai reader -- needs a browser. No DoorDash storefront found for this specific San Marcos location (a DoorDash 'Nacho's Nachos Taco Shop' exists but it's a different location, in Santee -- not used, per the one-branch's-menu-is-not-another-branch's-id rule). Needs: a browser on the Uber Eats storefront (or zmenu) to get current per-item prices; the allmenus data is real but too old to trust.
notes: A real, structured per-item menu exists (allmenus) but its price level reads as roughly 15 years stale; not used as the priced source.
